title.narrative: Secondment of SL to EEAS Stratcom

description.narrative: Secondment of international expert to EEAS Stratcom with the aim of supporting Eastern Neighbourhood partner countries in developing their capacities and policy frameworks on strengthening democratic media. The position will contribute to supporting media in the Eastern Neighbourhood through networks of journalists and media-related NGOs.
